xarch/modules/review/domain/published.py.why: Domain values of the review module that its contract re-exports: the contract only publishes them, and they are defined and used inside the module.

xarch/modules/rules/application/logic/se.why: Pure logic that decides what a finding says from the rules; it produces text, but the cli reports only print it.

xarch/modules/rules/domain/published.py.why: Domain values of the rules module that its contract re-exports: the contract only publishes them, and they are defined and used inside the module.

xarch/modules/spec/application/logic/doc.why: Pure logic that fills the document templates from the profile; it produces text, but writing and printing happen elsewhere.

xarch/platform/yaml_writer.py.why: Writes yaml text with the yaml library, which only platform may import; it is a tool the adapters are handed, not shared kernel code.
